name: Sending Stones

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Sending
powers.text: Once per dawn, cast Sending to the bearer of the other stone.

summary: A pair of stones: once a day, send a short message to whoever holds the other.
text: Sending Stones come in pairs, with each stone carved to match the other so the pairing is easily recognized. While you touch one stone, you can cast Sending from it. The target is the bearer of the other stone. If no creature bears the other stone, you know that fact as soon as you use the stone, and you don't cast the spell. Once Sending is cast using the stones, they can't be used again until the next dawn. If one of the stones in a pair is destroyed, the other one becomes nonmagical.
